Get posterior predictive trajectories of the sorted populations.

Source: R/predictive.R
get_predicted_trajectories.Rd

For every posterior draw and every time of a grid, the latent "-" and "+" sizes of the wild type and of every driver (and dc/driver-only) clade are computed with the model's growth/switch approximation. Observations are then generated as in the likelihood of the Stan model: for each population, its total count is drawn from `lognormal(log(Z- + Z+), sigma_count)` and its split in "+" cells from `beta_proportion(Z+ / (Z- + Z+), kappa)`. The private populations driver_n and driver_p live in one compartment and only get the lognormal count, as do wt/dc clades whose observed "-" count is 0. CCFs are evaluated on the sampled counts, within the "-" and "+" samples; wt clades and dc clades are subpopulations of wt and dc and do not enter the sample sizes. The total population size (`z_tot` of `pop = "total"`) follows the likelihood of the intermediate total counts, `lognormal(log(ztot_lat), sigma_count)`, with `ztot_lat` the latent size of all populations except the clades.

Usage

get_predicted_trajectories(
  x,
  times = NULL,
  n_grid = 30,
  t_start = 0,
  noise = TRUE
)

Arguments

x

PEPI_Multirates object fit with fit_multirates().

times

Time grid. If NULL, `n_grid` equally spaced times from `t_start` to the last observed time + 0.25, plus the observed times.

n_grid

Number of points of the default time grid.

t_start

First time of the default time grid.

noise

If TRUE (default), sample the observations; if FALSE, return the latent trajectories.

Value

A tibble with one row per draw (`samp`), `time` and population (`pop`, `id`; `pop = "total"` is the whole population) and columns `z_neg`, `z_pos` (counts), `z_tot` (total size, only for `"total"`), `frac_pos` (fraction of "+" cells within the population), `ccf_neg`, `ccf_pos` (CCF in the "-" and "+" samples).
